newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX lower.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent diesel fuel and unleaded gasoline prices were down across the board on Tuesday, tracking weaker NYMEX futures prices in morning trade.
Differentials in Group Three and Chicago firmed in reaction to the falling heating oil and unleaded futures and the outage of a key Group Three refinery, traders said.
Farmland Industries' 28,000 barrel per day catalytic cracker was in the midst of unscheduled maintenance expected to continue through the week, traders said.
"Basis is firmer, which was expected," one trader said.
The Williams pipeline system reported a 41 day supply of low sulphur diesel fuel and 22 day supply of unleaded gasoline on hand, down from seasonal-high levels posted last month.
Low sulphur diesel was bid 0.75 cent a gallon over NYMEX March heating oil in Group Three and 1.75 cents over the print in Chicago for prompt barrels, traders said.
High sulphur diesel was bid 2.50 cents under the print in Group Three and even with the print in Chicago.
Unleaded gasoline was talked 0.25 cent under to even with NYMEX March unleaded in Group Three and 2.50/2.25 cents under the print in Chicago.
Jet/kero firmed to 3.25/3.50 cents over the print in Group Three and 3.75/4.0 cents over in Chicago, continuing a steady climb of late.
